name: Wholeness
overview: Scripture reveals that wholeness encompasses both physical healing and spiritual restoration, as God promises to restore health and heal wounds (Jeremiah 30:17) and sends His word to deliver from destruction (Psalms 107:20). Jesus empowers believers to overcome sickness and evil, granting authority to heal and cast out unclean spirits (Matthew 10:1, Mark 16:17), reflecting the abundant life He came to give (John 10:10). The LORD’s blessing of strength and peace upon His people (Psalms 29:11) further underscores that true wholeness is found in the sustaining presence and power of God.
